messages.subject: showing only upper error bars
parts:
Hi!

Is there a way to draw only the upper error bars with geom_errobar?
or maybe to give different colors to the upper/lower error bars?

Thanks!
Shai

messages.author: c4ad98ee09d9ee51
messages.subject: Re: showing only upper error bars
parts:
Hi Shai,

Instead of

Graph + geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = value + error, ymin = value -
error))

try just,

Graph + geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = -value - error)

Alexa
